name: suigar
description: Suigar MCP tools for reading game config and building unsigned Sui game transactions.

interface.shortDescription: Build unsigned Suigar game transactions on Sui
interface.longDescription: Suigar adds MCP tools for reading Suigar network config, inspecting game metadata, and building or dry-running unsigned Sui transactions for coinflip, limbo, plinko, range, wheel, and PvP coinflip.
